name: Squig Herder
description: A Squig Herder spends his life among things that bite, and it shows: he is missing pieces, he flinches at nothing, and the one squig he keeps on a short rope is the meanest of a mean bunch. He does not command it so much as aim it.

abilities.name: Handle Animal
abilities.text: Friendly `BEAST` and `MONSTER` fighters within 6" of this fighter may use this fighter's Bravery characteristic when taking Bravery tests.

abilities.name: Netter
abilities.text: When an enemy fighter finishes a move action within 1" of this fighter, roll a die. On a 4+, that fighter may not make attack actions until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Loose Da Squig!
abilities.text: Select a visible enemy fighter within (X)" of this fighter. Allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter. If that fighter is within 1" of another visible enemy fighter, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter as well.
